description: This source file implements a custom version of the getopt() function for parsing command line options, including handling Unicode support on Windows. It defines the getopt() function, manages external variables for argument parsing, and includes a class method for processing command line arguments within the Thunder::Core namespace.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: A class within the Thunder::Core namespace responsible for parsing command line options.

methods.name: Options::Parse
methods.description: Parses command line arguments using the custom getopt() implementation and sets internal command and options.
